name: studium
description: Studium — unofficial, read-only study companion for universities running a Chamilo-based LMS: Android app, MCP server and shared core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @studium/core && npm run build -w @studium/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @studium/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
